wordbook.radicalDescription: 讠 is the simplified side form of 言. It often appears in words related to speaking and communication.
冂 is an enclosing radical. It appears around or near characters with an open-frame shape.
寸 originally related to a hand and a small unit of measure.
氵 is the side form of 水 and often marks water-related characters.
戈 is an ancient weapon radical and part of 我's historical form.
亻 is the side form of 人. It often marks people or human actions.
亻 is the side form of 人 and marks this pronoun as a person.
女 is the woman radical and distinguishes 她 as the pronoun for a woman.
女 is the woman radical in 妈, the character used for mother.
父 is the father radical and also a character meaning father.
儿 is the child radical and appears in words connected with descendants.
女 is the woman radical and the first character in daughter.
一 is both the character for one and a basic dictionary radical.
二 is both the character for two and a two-stroke radical.
The three strokes build 三; dictionaries commonly classify it under 一.
十 is both the character for ten and a dictionary radical.
人 is the radical in 今, although its form has changed through history.
日 is the sun radical in 明 and appears in many time-related characters.
日 is the sun radical in 昨 and often appears in characters about days and time.
王 is the dictionary radical in 现 and is linked to the jade component.
宀 often appears in characters connected with homes, rooms, and shelter.
子 is the child radical in 学, fitting a place where children learn.
饣 is the simplified side form of 食 and often identifies food-related words.
口 is the mouth radical in 商; it is a component rather than the meaning of a shop.
米 is the character and radical for rice, grain, and food.
艹 is the grass radical and often marks plants, herbs, and plant products.
艹 is the top radical in 苹 and often appears in plant names.
艹 is the grass radical, fitting vegetables and plant foods.
口 often appears in characters involving the mouth, eating, or drinking.
目 groups characters connected with seeing, eyes, and attention.
口 is the mouth radical in 听 and reflects its historical sound-related form.
讠 is the simplified side form of 言 and appears in language-related words.
木 is the tree radical in 来, reflecting an older character form.
厶 is a small radical historically associated with private or self.
囗 is the enclosure radical surrounding the inner part of 回.
亻 is the side form of 人 and appears in the action word 住.
大 is both the character for big and a dictionary radical.
小 is both the character for small and a dictionary radical.
夕 is the evening radical. Two 夕 components form 多.
小 is the dictionary radical in 少 and helps show its simple stroke structure.
